card: aifoundry3 card 0 (/dev/et0_*; the card's lock /run/lock/etsoc-shire0.lock); one session of ours on aifoundry3 at a time

card_time.how: the smoke (90 s) + 38 runs at E206 arm A's measured 21.96 s a run on this card + 300 s of the session's reads and gates
card_time.registered_subset_if_cut: the smoke, family X and family W (35 processes): family C is NO DATA if the session ends before it
card_time.rule: no run starts once the card time (the first device access to now) passes 30 minutes; at 35 the session ends after the run in progress (a started run is cut only by a stop)

clock: 600 MHz pinned (a boot-time TDP of 0 latches the governor), nothing set
die_gate: min(60, the session's rest die + 4) C, at most 300 s, else that run is NO DATA
go: his standing words (Sun 15 Nov 2026: 10:05:42, 10:22:36, 17:21:16; at or before 21:51:09) and his matmul focus (Mon 16 Nov 2026, at or before 09:48:24 PST); the model session's relayed words of 23:15:25 PST Mon 16 Nov 2026
identity: before every process the runner gates its --kernel by its arm family (ident_e211.py --gate: gemmL and gemmLnc rgm136's .text and whole ELF or loadable identity, gemmLn rgm211's) and records the gate's words with the run; gemmL runs rgm136's host (E206's build), gemmLn and gemmLnc rgm211's host; rgm211's host is gated by its behaviour (its early refusals of a malformed arm, before the device opens) and every launch's walk check
order: points-e211.json order: the smoke; family X; family W; family C (family C after family W, critic-kernel2 fix 4)

predicted_peak.how: MM1-v1's blind-day planning form (26.0 W high-side rest + 1.10 x W over idle + 1 W); F1's (its rest + W + 4 W); E206 arm A on this card read board peaks up to about 6 W over F1's point (59.54 W at most); E101's gemmnc1 on this card read 56.1 W at the board (p80) at one block

queue: aifoundry3, after E207 (Q199) and E210 (Q202) there; E211 books no card, on any box, before E207's data commit (its twins 2x3x2, 3x3x4 and 6x6x6 fp32 are E207 blind points)
reads_only: dmcmd_audit_v2 GO with every send site READ before the first device access; no statistics reset, no set of any kind (TDP, threshold, clock, voltage), no reset, no power cycle, no firmware change; et-who, who, uptime and ps read before the session; the card's lock held for the session; the ops node's creation abort harmless on a card held alone
rest: the first card command at least 40 minutes after our previous session on aifoundry3 ended
run_form: E206's: the die gate, 10 s at rest (p_rest = the median of its last 5 s), one host process --seconds 6 --budget 7.5 under a plain timeout 10 (never -k), a 4 s tail
smoke: 30 s at rest (the session's rest reading; the die gates from it); one checked short process each of s01 (gemmL2x2x2, rgm136), s02 (gemmLn2x2x2, rgm211) and s03 (gemmLnc2x2x2, rgm211's host on rgm136's ELF): each rc 0, every launch ok, the check of C exact or approx, walk_ok true on every launch (s02 nm, s03 mn), its cycles an op 50-250% of MM1's counter-mean forecast, the board 2 W or more over the rest; then the stop-path test on live samples (no launch)
start_config_gate: TDP 0 W, 65 C, 600 MHz as found (read, nothing set)

stops.die_reading: the shires' mean (minshire[0]) at or above 70 C, or the hottest-sensor latch (minshire[2]) once it has risen during the session above the lowest value it read since the session's first sample and reads at or above 70 C (E206 A1 item 1)
stops.kernel_stops: any check of C wrong, tensor_error, walk check failed (walk_ok false), launch timeout or identity gate failure in a gemmLn or gemmLnc process stops the session: nothing more that day
stops.stop_words: a stop touches the host's --stop-file (the host ends at its next launch boundary), never a kill; no run sends or arranges a SIGKILL to a device process; every device process under a plain timeout 10, never -k; a host hung past its TERM is reported and left (THE HUNG MARKER: stop, keep the booking, report to the owner, no session that day; no reset, no PCIe recovery, no driver reload, no power cycle)

what: the registered plan; the kit implements it; a departure is a dated amendment before the data it touches
window: G = the card lane's booking on its day; last start G + 1:30, last end G + 3:30, each rounded up to the whole minute, inside the Pacific day; G at 20:29:00 PST or earlier
